page_note: 该页为 OECD 就业展望附录图 1.C.1，用 15 个小倍图折线面板展示 2019 年 5 月至 2024 年 5 月各国名义与实际最低工资的累计百分比变化。

heading.title: Minimum wage evolution, May 2019 to May 2024
heading.subtitle: Nominal and real minimum wage, cumulative percentage change since May 2019

components.evidence: 15 identical line panels in a 3-column grid, Australia through Israel
each panel carries its own name above it: "Australia", "Belgium", "Chile", "Hungary"
one grey legend strip above all panels governing every panel
legend strip sits between the subtitle line and the first row of panels
Canada Federal Jurisiction runs -40 to 160, Hungary -30 to 90, others -20 to 60
Estonia real line reaches about -10; ticks -10, -20 printed on most panels
a black horizontal rule drawn at 0 across each panel
Nominal minimum wage moves in flat treads with vertical risers, e.g. Australia at May-22
"May-19".."May-24" tick text is turned about 45 degrees under every panel
time written as "May-19", "Nov-23" rather than ISO dates
lines move monthly but ticks appear only every six months, May and Nov
axes show bare numbers; "cumulative percentage change since May 2019" only in the heading line
every plot area carries a light grey fill instead of white
15 panels x 2 monthly series x ~61 months of plotted points

new_components.name: panel_title_two_line_qualifier
new_components.evidence: "Canada" appears twice, disambiguated only by a second line: "Federal Jurisiction" and "Weighted"
new_components.why_it_matters: 仅用面板主标题无法唯一定位数值，必须把第二行限定词一起作为寻址键，否则两个 Canada 面板会混淆。

new_components.name: stepped_and_sawtooth_series_pair
new_components.evidence: nominal series is a pure step line while the real series is a sawtooth eroding between steps
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一面板内两条线形态不同，读取某月数值时须先判断该系列是台阶平台还是持续下滑段。

difficulty_notes: 面板极小（每个绘图区高度约 130 px，覆盖 -20 到 60 共 80 个单位，10 个单位刻度间距仅约 16 px），要把 5 读到 ±0.25、把 2 读到 ±0.1、把 -1 判成负号而非 0，都远超像素分辨能力；Canada Federal Jurisiction 一格 40 个单位更甚。相比之下寻址虽需三个键（面板名+系列名+月份），但键都是印在页上的文字，仍可写入表格；真正卡住的是数值本身。

suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段中为每个面板单独存 y 轴范围与刻度序列，寻址键加入面板名
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 面板数 ≥12 且各面板轴范围不同时的数值命中率对比统一轴范围的小倍图

suggestions.what_to_add: step_line_series 作为线型风格维度
suggestions.where_to_change: 折线族的 style 字段增加 step/线性插值开关
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 台阶线 vs 直连线在同一取值任务下的读数误差行

suggestions.where_to_change: 面板标题字段拆为 name + qualifier，并在导出的表格上方以粗体写出
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 面板主名重复、仅靠第二行限定词区分时的上下文命中率

suggestions.what_to_add: 逐标记可达精度（readable 改为连续量）
suggestions.where_to_change: 评分条件行：按面板像素高度/轴跨度计算容差，而非固定 5%
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 面板高度 <150 px 且刻度间距 <20 px 时的可读性阈值行

suggestions.what_to_add: 标题五分拆（编号/标题/副标题/单位/位置）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图头记录字段，单位短语来自副标题而非轴
